xhs.title: Rust 借用：一条规则就够了
xhs.body:
第 8 课：& 和 &mut
只想用一下，不想交出所有权？加 & 借给它
想让函数改它：变量用 mut，再借 &mut
规则只有一条：多个只读 & 或者一个 &mut，不能同时
借用在最后一次使用后就结束，先读完再改就能编译
你被借用检查器拦过几次？评论区聊聊～

douyin.body: 多个只读借用，或者一个可变借用，不能同时。

tiktok.body: Rust borrowing in one rule: many & readers OR one &mut writer, never both at once.

linkedin.title: Rust's borrowing rule fits in one line
linkedin.body:
&: lend a value without giving up ownership. Read-only, and you can have many.
&mut: lend it to be changed. Only one at a time.
Mix them and the compiler refuses to build, which rules out data races.
A borrow ends at its last use, so read first, then write.
Which borrow-checker error tripped you up the most?
